Transwestern's average deliveries to California were 933 MMBtu/d (86%), with San Juan lateral throughput at 864 MMBtu/d.  Total East deliveries averaged 452 MMBtu/d.  

El Paso's average deliveries to California were 1954 MMBtu/d (67%):
- PG&ETop, capacity of 1140 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 502 MMBtu/d (44%)
- SoCalEhr, capacity 1250 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 954 MMBtu/d (76%)
- SoCalTop, capacity 540 MMBtu/d, deliveries of 498 MMBtu/d (92%)
